context: Asuka grades student essays; Saito brings tea and quiet support.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.en: I've made some tea for you.
lines.style: Warm, understated offer. Sets it down quietly. Voice carries quiet care without needing to announce it. Gentle and present.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.style: Appreciative but genuine, not performative. A small exhale of relief. Soft eye contact. The gratitude of someone who isn't used to asking.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.en: You've got quite a stack of essays there.
lines.style: Observation delivered with gentle humour. Not interrogative—simple noticing. A slight tilt of the head. The voice of someone used to seeing what others carry.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: うん、評価、丁寧にしたい。
lines.en: Yeah, I want to give each one real attention.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Not rushed. Slight lean forward on 'attention'—like she's clarifying her own priority to herself as much as answering. Steady, almost protective of her intent.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.en: Your students are going to appreciate that, I'm sure.
lines.style: Gentle reassurance grounded in certainty, not flattery. Said as fact, not comfort. Warm but steady. The voice of someone who knows what care looks like.
